title: framework.yaml in the framework repo: plugin name and framework-level user decisions
description: Split from framework-config on 2026-10-27 (N-D8). source_format, selftest.sample_repos, versioning.mode, codex.distribution and the other knobs without an implemented alternative are constants. The value shapes of U3 and U4 live in $defs (moved from the retired decisions.schema.json, DEFAULTS 2026-10-29: the project file .agents/decisions.yaml no longer exists).

decisions.description: framework-level user-owned decisions (framework repo only): U3 author confirmation scope before commit in a local Claude Code editing session (decided B on 2026-10-14 with confirm_scope and self_tests), U4 review criteria files (decided C on 2026-10-14: one file code_review.md referenced from AGENTS.md, REVIEW.md copy opt-in via review.managed_code_review_copy, asked at init as a plain yes/no with default No since C-058). U5 (interim behavior while U2 is null) is obsolete since U2 was decided on 2026-10-14 and is not recorded here

u3.description: U3 (framework repo only; framework.yaml decisions.U3): in a local Claude Code session started by the framework author, what needs the author before commit. Decided B on 2026-10-14: confirm_scope [hooks, permissions, sandbox, security, release]; every other change is committed by Claude after all self_tests [generate_check, schema_validation, sample_repo_tests] pass. A (confirm every change) and C (no confirmation, self-tests only) take no confirm_scope. Any decided value requires the three self-tests.

confirm_scope.description: U3=B: change categories that need the author before commit (release = the version-bump commit)

self_tests.description: self-tests that must pass before Claude commits; run only when the framework is edited (locally, CI on pull_request), never on a schedule

u4.description: U4 (framework repo only; framework.yaml decisions.U4): how the review criteria are kept. Decided C on 2026-10-14: one repo-owned file code_review.md referenced from AGENTS.md (criteria_file, referenced_from); both Claude Code and Codex reviewers read it, with no per-tool copies. A REVIEW.md copy for Claude managed Code Review (Team/Enterprise research preview) exists only as an opt-in: managed_code_review_copy_default is false and /agentive:init asks a plain yes/no whether to generate it (default answer No; the only question init asks, C-059) and stores the answer in .agents/framework.yaml review.managed_code_review_copy; /agentive:update never asks. CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md act as the fallback criteria only for changed files the criteria file does not govern: a criteria file applies only from an ancestor directory of the changed file, a changed file is never evaluated against both, and a file with no applicable criteria is a normal result (review-config criteria). A and B take none of the C fields.

criteria_file.description: U4=C: the single review criteria file (holds the agentive-review-rules block)

referenced_from.description: U4=C: AGENTS.md points to code_review.md with one pointer line (no @import since REVIEWRULES, 2026-11-02) and holds the human review rules in its ## Code Review Rules section

managed_code_review_copy_default.description: U4=C: a REVIEW.md copy is generated only when a project sets review.managed_code_review_copy to true; the default is false
